description: Book search: find public-domain books by title or author substring, e.g. 'Dickens' or 'Frankenstein', across 61,000+ indexed Project Gutenberg books. Returns matching books ranked by download popularity: book_id, title, author, Gutenberg release year, download_count and subjects; use book_id for metadata, chapters, quotes or full-text search. Costs $0.005 via x402 (requires WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, USDC on Base).
name: search_books
